011/**
012 * Automatic tester, that executes all 22 test cases in README.md.

014public class Tester {
015    private static int passedCount = 0;
016    private static int failedCount = 0;
017
018
019
020    /**
021     * Main entry point for executing all test cases.
022     * @param args Command-line arguments.
023     */
024    public static void main(String[] args) {
025        System.out.println("Executing Tester.java");
026        
027        runTestCase("case01", "Command Loop: Invalid Command", testCase01());
028        runTestCase("case02", "Command Loop: Case & Alias Recognition", testCase02());
029        runTestCase("case03", "Time Validation: Non-leap February 29", testCase03());
030        runTestCase("case04", "Time Validation: Leap Year February 29", testCase04());
031        runTestCase("case05", "Time Validation: Month Day Overflow", testCase05());
032        runTestCase("case06", "Time Validation: Component Bounds", testCase06());
033        runTestCase("case07", "Chronological Validation: Start Before End", testCase07());
034        runTestCase("case08", "Defensive Input: Blank Title & Blank Location", testCase08());
035        runTestCase("case09", "Add Activity: Complete Flow", testCase09());
036        runTestCase("case10", "Search: Element at Beginning of List", testCase10());
037        runTestCase("case11", "Search: Element in Middle of List", testCase11());
038        runTestCase("case12", "Search: Element at End of List", testCase12());
039        runTestCase("case13", "Search: Element Not on List", testCase13());
040        runTestCase("case14", "Keyword Matching: Word-Level Exactness", testCase14());
041        runTestCase("case15", "Keyword Matching: Case & Order Invariance", testCase15());
042        runTestCase("case16", "Time Period: Bounded Range", testCase16());
043        runTestCase("case17", "Time Period: Open End Range", testCase17());
044        runTestCase("case18", "Time Period: Open Start Range", testCase18());
045        runTestCase("case19", "Time Period: Invalid Inverted Range", testCase19());
046        runTestCase("case20", "Search: No Filters (Match All)", testCase20());
047        runTestCase("case21", "Title Index: Activity Addition", testCase21());
048        runTestCase("case22", "Persistence Verification (RAS Read/Write)", testCase22());
049
050        System.out.printf(String.format("Out of %d tests, %d passed and %d failed\n",
051            passedCount + failedCount, passedCount, failedCount));
052    }
053
054
055
056    /**
057     * Records and prints the outcome of a single test case.
058     * @param id The test case identifier.
059     * @param description Short description of what was tested.
060     * @param pass Whether the test passed.
061     */
062    public static void runTestCase(String id, String description, boolean pass) {
063        if (pass) {
064            passedCount++;
065            System.out.printf("[pass] %s: %s\n", id, description);
066        } else {
067            failedCount++;
068            System.out.printf("[FAIL] %s: %s\n", id, description);
069        }
070    }

074    /**
075     * Case 01: Verifies that unrecognized commands are rejected by the command loop.
076     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
077     */
078    public static boolean testCase01() {
079        java.io.PrintStream originalOut = System.out;
080        System.setOut(new java.io.PrintStream(new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()));
081        try {
082            Input input = new Input(new ByteArrayInputStream("bye\n".getBytes()));
083            String cmd = input.readCommand();
084            return MenuOption.parse(cmd) == null;
085        } finally {
086            System.setOut(originalOut);
087        }
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Case 02: Verifies that command aliases and case variations are recognized.
092     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
093     */
094    public static boolean testCase02() {
095        String[] addAliases = { "add", "ADD", "Add", "a", "A", "1", "insert" };
096        String[] searchAliases = { "search", "SEARCH", "Search", "s", "S", "2", "find" };
097        String[] quitAliases = { "quit", "QUIT", "Quit", "q", "Q", "3" };
098
099        for (String a : addAliases) {
100            if (MenuOption.parse(a) != MenuOption.ADD)
101                return false;
102        }
103
104        for (String s : searchAliases) {
105            if (MenuOption.parse(s) != MenuOption.SEARCH)
106                return false;
107        }
108
109        for (String q : quitAliases) {
110            if (MenuOption.parse(q) != MenuOption.QUIT)
111                return false;
112        }
113
114        return true;
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * Case 03: Verifies that February 29 is rejected in non-leap years.
119     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
120     */
121    public static boolean testCase03() {
122        boolean valid = Time.isValidTime(2026, 2, 29, 10, 0);
123        String err = Time.getValidationError(2026, 2, 29, 10, 0);
124        return !valid && err != null && err.contains("max 28 days");
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Case 04: Verifies that February 29 is accepted in leap years.
129     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
130     */
131    public static boolean testCase04() {
132        boolean isLeap = Time.isLeapYear(2024);
133        boolean valid = Time.isValidTime(2024, 2, 29, 10, 0);
134        return isLeap && valid;
135    }

137    /**
138     * Case 05: Verifies that dates exceeding the maximum days in a month are rejected.
139     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
140     */
141    public static boolean testCase05() {
142        boolean valid = Time.isValidTime(2026, 4, 31, 9, 0);
143        String err = Time.getValidationError(2026, 4, 31, 9, 0);
144        return !valid && err != null && err.contains("max 30 days");
145    }

147    /**
148     * Case 06: Verifies that out-of-bounds time components are rejected.
149     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
150     */
151    public static boolean testCase06() {
152        boolean badMonth = !Time.isValidTime(2026, 13, 1, 10, 0);
153        boolean badHour = !Time.isValidTime(2026, 5, 10, 24, 0);
154        boolean badMinute = !Time.isValidTime(2026, 5, 10, 12, 60);
155        boolean badYear = !Time.isValidTime(0, 1, 1, 10, 0);
156        return badMonth && badHour && badMinute && badYear;
157    }

159    /**
160     * Case 07: Verifies that start time must be chronologically before end time.
161     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
162     */
163    public static boolean testCase07() {
164        Time start = new Time(2026, 10, 15, 14, 0);
165        Time end = new Time(2026, 10, 15, 12, 0);
166        Time equalTime = new Time(2026, 10, 15, 14, 0);
167        return start.compareTo(end) > 0 && start.compareTo(equalTime) == 0;
168    }

349    /**
350     * Case 22: Verifies serializing activities to RAS format and reading them back.
351     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
352     */
353    public static boolean testCase22() {
354        String testDir;
355        try {
356            testDir = java.nio.file.Files.createTempDirectory("dayplanner-test-").toString();
357        } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
358            return false;
359        }
360        String testFile = "test_persistence.ras";
361
362        ActivityList outList = new ActivityList();
363        Time t1 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 10, 0);
364        Time t2 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 11, 0);
365
366        HomeActivity ha = new HomeActivity("Test Home", t1, t2, "Home Comment");
367        SchoolActivity sa = new SchoolActivity("Test School", t1, t2, "School Comment");
368        OtherActivity oa = new OtherActivity("Test Other", t1, t2, "Other Comment", "Library");
369
370        outList.add(ha);
371        outList.add(sa);
372        outList.add(oa);
373
374        boolean saved = outList.saveToRAS(testDir, testFile);
375        if (!saved) return false;
376
377        ActivityList inList = new ActivityList(testDir, testFile);
378        boolean sizeMatches = inList.size() == 3;
379        boolean equalData = inList.get(0).equals(ha) &&
380                            inList.get(1).equals(sa) &&
381                            inList.get(2).equals(oa);
382
383        // Clean up test file and directory
384        try {
385            Files.deleteIfExists(Path.of(testDir, testFile));
386            Files.deleteIfExists(Path.of(testDir));
387        } catch (IOException e) {
388            // ignore lol
389        }
390
391        return sizeMatches && equalData
392            && inList.findTitleMatches(new String[] { "Test" }).equals(java.util.Arrays.asList(0, 1, 2));
393    }
